title: INVIZ
description: Adds a craftable invisibility ability, allowing players to become invisible for 15 seconds or until their first attack.
body:
# 👻 INVIZ

Add a new stealth mechanic to your game and outsmart your enemies!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## ✨ Features

🔮 **Magic Dirt Block**
Craft a special block using 4 Dirt Blocks.

👻 **Become Invisible**
Activate the block to gain complete invisibility.

⏱️ **15 Seconds Duration**
Stay hidden for up to 15 seconds.

⚔️ **Attack Cancels Invisibility**
The effect immediately ends after your first hit.

🏃 **Perfect for Escaping**
Lose your pursuers and disappear at the perfect moment.

🎯 **Strategic Gameplay**
Create ambushes, fake routes, and surprise attacks.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## 📦 Crafting

🟫 4x Dirt Block → 🔮 Magic Dirt Block

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

## 🚀 Perfect For

🏃 Runner vs Hunter
⚔️ PvP Servers
🎮 Mini-Games
🌎 Survival Servers

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

**Disappear. Escape. Outsmart.**
